high_level_description: This image is a slide from a presentation, likely discussing the ventral visual stream in the human brain and its role in processing images. The slide is divided into two main sections: an illustration of a bird and a diagram of the ventral visual stream. Image of a Bird: A photograph of a bird, specifically a blue tit, is shown on the left side of the slide. The bird is depicted in profile, facing to the right. Text: Above the bird image, there is a title that reads, "Ventral stream as stack of cortical layers that compute abstract features from images."
